model_meta.description: Bar-feeding apparatus selectively couples a pushing rod or projecting rod to a movable transmission member along the feeder tube.

subsystems.description: Supports the feeder tube and mechanisms.
Receives bar material from the material rack for feeding to a processing machine; the pushing and projecting rods move axially along the feeder tube.

Includes a movable member with distinct retaining grooves: groove 462 engages the pushing-rod engagement portion, while groove 464 engages the projecting-rod engagement portion (Claims 1 and 8; detailed description).
Rotary shaft carries coupling and actuating members.
Engages transmission and moves axially along feeder tube to advance bar material.

Includes holder block 72 with through-hole 722 and positioning rod 726, and driven member 74 with locating rod 742; spring member 76 connects the locating and positioning rods, while the locating rod engages the pushing-rod groove and is received in the holder-block cutting groove (Claims 3–7).
Moves within feeder tube and selectively engages transmission to advance bar material.
Holds bar material supplied to the feeder tube.
External processing-machine destination, such as an automatic lathe, receiving bar material fed from the tube.

item_flows.name: Bar material
item_flows.notes: Received into feeder tube and delivered toward processing machine.

actions.name: Coordinate rod engagement and spring return

steps.description: Rotary-shaft rotation turns the coupling member and actuating member. The projecting rod is connected to the coupling member; shaft motion moves it between positions in which its engagement portion engages or disengages retaining groove 464, with the disengaged position moved away from the feeder tube.

When the actuating-member protrusion presses the driven-member protrusion, the driven member rotates the pushing rod via the locating-rod/pushing-rod groove engagement, disengaging pushing-rod engagement portion from groove 462 and stretching the spring (Claims 2–5, 7–8).

When the actuating protrusion disengages, the spring returns the driven member and pushing rod so the pushing-rod engagement portion re-engages groove 462. Complementary configurations: pushing rod coupled means it moves axially while projecting rod is disengaged; pushing rod disconnected means projecting rod is coupled and moves axially (Claim 1).
